signals.title: Central, Gqeberha (Russell Rd, approx.): man, 52, shot dead in his car, 19 Oct
signals.content: Police say a man of 52 was shot by two male suspects while sitting in his car, a white VW Polo, outside a corner shop in Russell Road, Central, Gqeberha, at about 12:50 on Monday 19 October. He tried to get out, collapsed behind the car and died at the scene; the suspects fled in another white VW Polo (police spokesperson Brigadier Nobuntu Gantana, via The Herald). Humewood police opened a murder case. Algoa FM, in its own reporting after citing police, says the motive is unknown at this stage. No arrest has been reported. The victim is not named here. Three reports, all resting on police: The Herald, Algoa FM and PE Express (PE Express gives his age as 50).
